blockers.detail: The isolated Vercel Hobby project reached its API deployment limit during this pass. Source remains deploy-ready; do not burn additional deploy attempts until the limit resets.
Public SEO mode requires a stable production origin so canonical URLs, sitemap, robots, RSS, security.txt and structured data resolve to one permanent host.

featureGates.detail: Waitlist may collect interest via user-sent email. Free-shirt drawing entries must not open until official rules, dates and eligibility terms are published.
Remaining sources are Drive-restricted and the connected GitHub writer cannot commit binary MP3 bytes. Catalogue fallback remains explicit.
Approved BillYen source assets are documented but not present as repository binaries. Direct profile uses a deliberate typographic fallback rather than generated or unrelated photography.
Vercel Web Analytics is optional. Current connector can read analytics but cannot enable the project-level feature.
